verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no IMAP, JMAP or SMTP access and no standards-based export offered by Shortwave itself. The founder states it integrates with Gmail's APIs rather than IMAP, and users complain it only works with Gmail. Users can leave because their mail remains in Gmail, but that is a host-platform property, not a Shortwave capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
